question: Has the October 12 start date been reviewed against the weather window? A 10–16 week addition starting Oct 12 puts foundation and framing in late October–November, approaching the mid-December weather risk period TCR avoids for outdoor phases.
why_it_matters: TCR's scheduling policy requires 20% weather buffer on outdoor phases; framing running into December without buffer increases odds of a delayed close-in and interior start slip (belief: weather_window_risk_assessment).
